turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, is that Alan? This is an automated call from Fieldgate Surgery, following up on your appointment. I am not able to take questions, but the practice will read everything you tell me. If you would rather not talk now, just hang up and we will not call again.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Since your appointment, are you feeling better, about the same, or worse?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Worse, if I'm honest. It's the mornings mostly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your medication was changed at that appointment. Are you managing to take it as prescribed?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: I'm taking it, but I'm not sure I've got the timing right. The pharmacist said one thing and the letter said another.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Is there anything you would like the practice to know?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: I can't get up the stairs the way I could a fortnight ago, and I'm having to stop halfway.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to be seen again about this?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Yes, please. Mornings are difficult though, if that can be helped.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Someone at the practice will read this today. Goodbye.
